_comment: Sites the maintainer confirmed are freely readable from Singapore in a normal browser, but which refuse the cloud browser used by scripts/verify_sources.mjs. For these hosts only, a browser block is double-checked with a plain download: the story passes (with a warning) if the full article text comes through. Re-test them now and then.
